_help: PC TidyUp settings. Rules (what counts as cache/log/temp/...) live in tidyup.rules.json. Globs use the same syntax and variables as the rules.
_archive: Archive to OneDrive: items are moved under one common root, mirroring their original path (C:/x/y -> <root>/C/x/y), then made online-only once uploaded. leave_link = default of the 'leave a link' option.
_priority: Thresholds for the priority guide (P1 do now, P2 quick check, P3 decide, P4 optional) and the disk health verdict.
_app: Local web app (PC-TidyUp.cmd): port 0 = pick a free one; stops by itself when no page is open for idle_shutdown_minutes.
_protected: No file-level advice (compress/archive/delete) inside these; only dir_rules marked system:true may match here.
_advice_exclude: App-internal data: no compress/archive/offload/duplicate advice here (folder and file rules still apply).
_duplicates_exclude: Duplicates inside these are by design (installed packages, app data) and are not reported.
_skip: Folders not scanned at all (their size is not counted).
_cloud_sync_roots: Extra synced folders (SharePoint libraries etc.). OneDrive is detected automatically from file attributes and the OneDrive environment variables.
